title: elaeagnus magna
intro: Elaeagnus magna, commonly known as the silverberry or wolfberry, is a deciduous shrub native to China, Japan, and Korea. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may aid in reducing oxidative stress, alleviating symptoms of diabetes and cancer, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Elaeagnus magna include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Elaeagnus magna, including vitexin, isovitexin, and syringic acid, contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
